name: The Cat You'll Never Forget
source:
What happens when a pink cat that needs you to love him can have that love whenever he wants? A few soft purrs. A few swings of the watch. Unbroken eye-contact. Then you'll be his, just as much as he'll belong to you. You just have to walk him home first, and you'll get to be with the cat of your dreams. Sounds simple, right? You'd know all about it, wouldn't you? ... or I guess you shouldn't. S'why we're here.

[From [url=https://hypnocatto.itch.io/the-cat-youll-never-forget]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一只需要你爱他的粉红猫可以随时得到你的爱时，会发生什么？几声轻柔的呼噜声。手表晃动了几下。不间断的目光接触。到时候你就属于他了，就像他也属于你一样。你只需先送他回家，然后你就能和你梦想中的猫在一起了。听起来很简单，对吧？你会知道这一切，不是吗？…或者我想你不应该。这就是我们来这里的原因。

[来自[url=https://hypnocatto.itch.io/the-cat-youll-never-forget]itch.io[/url]]
